instruments.label: GEMINI_SETTLEMENT_GATE_V1
labels: REALIZED is the venue's cash movement. reconstructed_cash is arithmetic on our own records and is a cross-check only.
inferred_settlement_value comes from the underlying and is a MODEL. It is never realized, whatever it agrees with.
rebates and rewards are separate ledgers and never enter trading P&L until actually credited and source-accounted.

gate.authorizes: nothing on its own. An OPEN gate means settlement accounting CAN close, not that a probe is approved. Live authorization remains a separate human decision.

labels: READ ONLY. No order transport is imported or reachable here.
a 404 on a settlement candidate is a RESULT: it says the credit does not live there, which is what nobody had established.
no credential value is read, printed, logged or returned by this module; it only reports whether one was present.
